def short_repr(item, max_length=15):
    repr_str = repr(item)
    if len(repr_str) <= max_length:
        return repr_str
    else:
        # For dictionaries, try to show a truncated version
        if isinstance(item, dict):
            # Get first few items and show them
            items = list(item.items())[:3]  # Show first 3 items
            if len(item) > 3:
                truncated = '{' + ', '.join(f'{k!r}: {v!r}' for k, v in items) + ', ...}'
            else:
                truncated = '{' + ', '.join(f'{k!r}: {v!r}' for k, v in items) + '}'
            # If the truncated version is still too long, truncate it further
            if len(truncated) > max_length:
                # Try to fit at least one item
                if items:
                    # Start with first item and add ...
                    first_item = f'{items[0][0]!r}: {items[0][1]!r}'
                    if len(first_item) + 5 <= max_length:  # +5 for '{..., ...}'
                        return f'{{{first_item}, ...}}'
                    else:
                        # Even the first item is too long, truncate it
                        return f'{{...}}'
                else:
                    return f'{{...}}'
            return truncated
        else:
            # For other types, truncate at max_length
            return repr_str[:max_length-3] + '...'
